# Zstore AI — One Ribbon

> Zstore AI is the one-person web studio of designer-developer Zvi Moshe (Tel Aviv, Israel), serving clients across the United States and worldwide. This site is itself the proof of craft: one real-time ribbon of orange enamel and polished chrome, hand-written in WebGL2 with zero dependencies, runs through the whole page — from a figure-eight in the hero to the folded Z logo at the contact section.

Site: https://nz-web.netlify.app/
Language: English (work is done in English and Hebrew).

## What Zstore AI does

- Custom websites & landing pages — designed and hand-coded around one clear idea; no templates or page builders.
- Digital product design (UI/UX) — user journeys, screen design and design systems for products that feel calm and obvious.
- Integrations & connections — payments, bookings, forms and content editing wired into the site.
- Refinement & care — ongoing speed, accessibility and SEO improvements after launch.

## How working together goes

1. Discover — one real conversation about the business, the audience and what a win looks like.
2. Design — a living, clickable preview refined together.
3. Develop — hand-written code, tested on real phones, tablets and desktops.
4. Launch — go-live with speed, search and accessibility checks done, then 30 days of included care.

Key facts:
- One person carries every project end to end: the person you brief is the person who designs and codes it.
- Pricing: one fixed price per written scope, agreed before work starts. Quotes are personal — there is no public price list.
- Typical timelines: landing page about 1–2 weeks; complete site about 4–6 weeks.
- Location & hours: based in Tel Aviv; asynchronous-friendly, with hours kept free for live calls with US time zones.
- After launch: 30 days of care included; light ongoing arrangements available.

## Portfolio note

The three works shown (Atelier Studio, Lume, Meridian) are self-initiated concept studies with invented branding and illustrative sample data — clearly labelled on the site, not commissioned client work.
